samples.text:
[MSU January/February 2027 Intake Advert, p. 1]
FACULTY: Faculty of Agriculture, Environment and Natural Resources Management
FACULTY NOTE: (‘O’ Level Maths required for all programmes)
PROGRAMME: Bachelor of Science Honours Degree in Agricultural Economics and Development
LEVEL: Undergraduate – Bachelor’s degree
DURATION AS ADVERTISED: 4 years
ENTRY REQUIREMENTS: Any two A level passes in Sciences or Commercial subjects preferably Agriculture, Mathematics, Economics, Management of Business, Sociology, Accounts, Geography and Biology
MODES OF ENTRY: Gweru Conventional
INTAKE ADVERT: January/February 2027
GENERAL ADVERT REQUIREMENT: Applicants must hold at least 5 ‘O’ level passes at grade C or better, including ENGLISH LANGUAGE in addition to the specified ‘A’ level subjects or diplomas.
SOURCE: Original MSU January/February 2027 intake advert, page 1
